doc.title: Context collapse
doc.body:
Asking a model to rewrite an accumulated context end to end progressively destroys it.

## What was measured

An unbounded rewrite collapsed a context from 18,282 tokens to 122 — below the no-context baseline, meaning the compression was worse than having no context at all.

## Why a ratio target does not fix it

A compiler given a 75% ratio target delivered ~35% and tripled catastrophic failures. The same compiler with an external probe measuring what was dropped recovered ~80% of the loss.
